articles.title: Parrish vs. Crombie: The bitter rematch shaping Mississauga's municipal campaign
articles.summary: In Mississauga, incumbent Mayor Carolyn Parrish is facing former mayor Bonnie Crombie. With a crowded field and a high-profile showdown at the top of the ticket, the central question hanging over the campaign is whether the drama will actually get residents to the polls.

articles.title: Grocery-style food bank aims to meet rising demand in Durham Region
articles.summary: Food bank visits in Durham Region have surged since the pandemic, according to Feed the Need Durham. The organization is turning to a grocery-style model it says can help make better use of food while giving people more choice. CBC’s Rochelle Raveendran has more.

articles.title: Debris recovered from Canadian air ambulance that went missing off U.S. coast
articles.summary: A Hamilton-based plane with six people aboard, including four Canadians, went missing during a flight from Bermuda to Boston

articles.title: 16-year-old charged with manufacturing firearm parts, threatening Pickering school
articles.summary: Police say a 16-year-old boy is facing charges after allegedly threatening to carry out a shooting at a Pickering, Ont., high school and making firearm parts with a 3D printer.

articles.title: What to see at Nuit Blanche Toronto 2026
articles.summary: Old and new favourites are among the top projects as the night’s main exhibition takes over downtown with an underground rave, marching band and more. The 12-hour event returns Saturday, Oct. 3, at sundown.
